Clubs & Campus Leadership

I founded two clubs, helped revive another, served on student organization boards, and took part in several other campus communities.

The Communities I Helped Lead

Student organizations were a major part of my college experience. Alongside the fun of the activities themselves, there was the work of arranging meetings, communicating with members, working with a board, and helping things happen.

Founder & President

Pokémon Club

I founded the club and helped build a campus community around the many parts of Pokémon: video games, cards, Pokémon GO, Showdown, and more.

Explore Pokémon Club

Founder & President

Harry Potter Club

I founded the club and worked with its board to organize in-person meetings around a shared interest in Harry Potter.

Explore Harry Potter Club

Co-reviver & President

Fencing Club

I brought the club back in spring 2024, with instruction, equipment, and a place to learn and practice fencing.

Explore Fencing Club

Secretary → President

Muhlenberg Board Game Association

I helped with communications and social media as Secretary, then ran weekly board game meetings with the board as President.

Explore MBGA

Member → After Dark Events Coordinator

Muhlenberg Activities Council

Through MAC, I helped plan and support campus events, including late-night and alcohol-involved programming.

Other Campus Involvement

Israeli Dance Troupe

I participated in Muhlenberg’s Israeli Dance Troupe, להקת מהתחלה (“Lehakat Me’hatchala”). We learned newly choreographed dances to Israeli music and performed at Israeli folkdance festivals. Festivals in Boston, Washington, DC, and Manhattan were part of the troupe’s activities.

Troupe on Instagram

Wall Street Club

I was involved in a student community focused on financial markets, investment strategies, and careers in finance. Discussions and guest speakers were part of how the club explored those subjects.

Club on Instagram

Jewelry-Making Club

A chance to make things by hand alongside my technical and writing interests. I made a few bracelets and a necklace, and worked on a metal design.

Club on Instagram
